const payload = $json.body ?? $json;

const title = String(payload.title || '').trim();
const excerpt = String(payload.excerpt || '').trim();
const content = String(payload.content || '').trim();
const category = String(payload.category || '').trim();
const sourceUrl = String(payload.source_url || '').trim();
const requestedBy = payload.requested_by || {};

const articleText = [
  `Title: ${title || '[empty]'}`,
  `Category: ${category || '[empty]'}`,
  `Summary: ${excerpt || '[empty]'}`,
  `Reference URL: ${sourceUrl || '[none]'}`,
  'Content:',
  content || '[empty]'
].join('\n');

const searchPrompt = [
  'You are helping SharedSpace verify a user-submitted article draft using live trusted news sources.',
  'Search only these Tier 1 sources: Reuters, CNA, and The Straits Times.',
  'Find articles that directly support, partially support, contradict, or are strongly related to the draft headline and core claims.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON with this exact shape:',
  '{',
  '  "search_summary": "",',
  '  "matched_sources": [',
  '    {',
  '      "name": "Reuters | CNA | The Straits Times",',
  '      "tier": 1,',
  '      "title": "",',
  '      "url": "",',
  '      "snippet": "",',
  '      "match_type": "direct | related | partial | contradicts",',
  '      "relevance_note": ""',
  '    }',
  '  ]',
  '}',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- Return max 5 matched sources total across all domains.',
  '- Prefer direct matches over broad related stories.',
  '- Do not invent URLs, titles, or source names.',
  '- If no strong source is found, return an empty matched_sources array.',
  '- Allowed domains: reuters.com, cna.com, channelnewsasia.com, straitstimes.com.',
  '',
  'Article draft:',
  articleText
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    title,
    excerpt,
    content,
    category,
    source_url: sourceUrl,
    requested_by: requestedBy,
    article_text: articleText,
    search_prompt: searchPrompt
  }
}];

const matchedSources = Array.isArray($json.matched_sources) ? $json.matched_sources : [];
const matchedSourcesJson = JSON.stringify(matchedSources, null, 2);

const rubricPrompt = [
  'You are a strict news verification AI for SharedSpace. Score the article using the rubric exactly as specified.',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON matching the schema. Do not add commentary outside the JSON.',
  '',
  'RUBRIC:',
  'Trust Score = A + S + B + L + C. The category maximums already encode the weights: A 35, S 20, B 20, L 15, C 10.',
  'A = Factual Accuracy, max 35. Bands: 30-35 all verifiable claims confirmed by Tier 1; 20-29 most claims confirmed with <=2 minor unconfirmed details; 10-19 core claim confirmed but factual error or key contradiction exists; 0-9 core claim unverifiable, contradicted, or fabricated.',
  'S = Source Quality, max 20. Bands: 17-20 if >=2 distinct Tier 1 sources directly confirm or relate; 12-16 if exactly 1 Tier 1 source matches; 6-11 if only Tier 2 or tangential Tier 1; 0-5 if no Tier 1/Tier 2 match.',
  'B = Bias/Neutrality, max 20. Bands: 17-20 neutral; 11-16 mildly emotive or single-sided; 5-10 clearly one-sided or sensational; 0-4 inflammatory or fabricated quotes.',
  'L = Logical Consistency, max 15. Bands: 13-15 coherent; 8-12 minor logical leaps; 4-7 internal contradiction; 0-3 multiple contradictions.',
  'C = Completeness, max 10. Count 5W1H. 6 elements = 9 or 10; 5 = 7; 4 = 6; 3 = 4; fewer than 3 = 1.',
  '',
  'DETERMINISTIC RULES:',
  '- Use fixed band midpoints unless a sub-rule applies.',
  '- A midpoints: 30-35 => 32, 20-29 => 24, 10-19 => 14, 0-9 => 4.',
  '- For B, L, C choose only the stated fixed values where possible: B high 18, B medium 14, B low 7, B severe 3; L high 14, L medium 10, L low 5, L severe 2; C use 10, 7, 6, 4, or 1.',
  '- Sensational words deduct 3 points each from B band ceiling, max -9: shocking, outrage, explosive, bombshell, secret, exposes, wake up, they don\'t want you to know, mainstream media won\'t tell you, must share.',
  '- If a Tier 1 source directly contradicts the headline claim, set override_applied=true and force publish_decision=not_reliable.',
  '- If S=0 and A<=10, set override_applied=true and force publish_decision=not_reliable.',
  '- If Tier 1 sources contradict each other 1 vs 1, apply -8 to A and do not let A exceed 27.',
  '- If no matching sources support any claim, A=0 and S=0 unless the topic is clearly personal opinion.',
  '- If two rules conflict, the lower score wins.',
  '',
  'PUBLISH DECISION:',
  '- safe_to_publish if trust_score >= 75 AND A >= 25 AND B >= 13.',
  '- needs_review if score is 50-74 OR score >=75 but A<25 or B<13.',
  '- not_reliable if score <50 OR A<15 OR S=0, or any override applies.',
  '',
  'OUTPUT SCHEMA:',
  '{',
  '  "trust_score": 0,',
  '  "publish_decision": "safe_to_publish | needs_review | not_reliable",',
  '  "categories": {',
  '    "factual_accuracy": { "score": 0, "max": 35, "notes": "" },',
  '    "source_quality": { "score": 0, "max": 20, "notes": "" },',
  '    "bias_neutrality": { "score": 0, "max": 20, "notes": "" },',
  '    "logical_consistency": { "score": 0, "max": 15, "notes": "" },',
  '    "completeness": { "score": 0, "max": 10, "notes": "" }',
  '  },',
  '  "matched_sources": [',
  '    { "name": "", "tier": 1, "url": "", "match_type": "direct | related | partial | contradicts" }',
  '  ],',
  '  "flags": [],',
  '  "override_applied": false,',
  '  "override_reason": null',
  '}',
  '',
  'MATCHED SOURCES JSON:',
  matchedSourcesJson,
  '',
  'ARTICLE DRAFT:',
  $json.article_text || '[missing article text]'
].join('\n');

const compareRequest = {
  model: 'gpt-5-mini',
  reasoning: { effort: 'low' },
  text: {
    format: {
      type: 'json_schema',
      name: 'sharedspace_deterministic_score',
      strict: true,
      schema: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        properties: {
          trust_score: { type: 'integer' },
          publish_decision: { type: 'string' },
          categories: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              factual_accuracy: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, properties: { score: { type: 'integer' }, max: { type: 'integer' }, notes: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['score', 'max', 'notes'] },
              source_quality: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, properties: { score: { type: 'integer' }, max: { type: 'integer' }, notes: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['score', 'max', 'notes'] },
              bias_neutrality: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, properties: { score: { type: 'integer' }, max: { type: 'integer' }, notes: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['score', 'max', 'notes'] },
              logical_consistency: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, properties: { score: { type: 'integer' }, max: { type: 'integer' }, notes: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['score', 'max', 'notes'] },
              completeness: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, properties: { score: { type: 'integer' }, max: { type: 'integer' }, notes: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['score', 'max', 'notes'] }
            },
            required: ['factual_accuracy', 'source_quality', 'bias_neutrality', 'logical_consistency', 'completeness']
          },
          matched_sources: {
            type: 'array',
            items: {
              type: 'object',
              additionalProperties: false,
              properties: {
                name: { type: 'string' },
                tier: { type: 'integer' },
                url: { type: 'string' },
                match_type: { type: 'string' }
              },
              required: ['name', 'tier', 'url', 'match_type']
            }
          },
          flags: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
          override_applied: { type: 'boolean' },
          override_reason: { type: ['string', 'null'] }
        },
        required: ['trust_score', 'publish_decision', 'categories', 'matched_sources', 'flags', 'override_applied', 'override_reason']
      }
    }
  },
  input: [
    { role: 'system', content: 'Return JSON only. Apply the SharedSpace rubric deterministically using the supplied matched sources and article draft.' },
    { role: 'user', content: rubricPrompt }
  ]
};

return [{ json: { ...$json, matched_sources_json: matchedSourcesJson, compare_prompt: rubricPrompt, compare_request: compareRequest } }];
